BEACON_RECOMMEND_BUILD_OUTWARD: Stroy marshrut dalshe ot etogo yakorya, chtoby sohranyat svyaznost.
BEACON_RECOMMEND_CONFIRM_ROUTE: Podtverdi etot marshrut pered uhodom glubzhe.
BEACON_RECOMMEND_FRONTIER: Ispolzuy ee kak rubezhnuyu metku dlya glubokogo prodvizheniya ili othoda.
BEACON_RECOMMEND_LEAVE_ACTIVE: Ostav ee aktivnoy, esli ne svorachivaesh etot marshrut.
BEACON_RECOMMEND_LOCAL_MARK: Ispolzuy ee, chtoby otmetit blizhayshuyu tochku interesa.
BEACON_RECOMMEND_RELAY: Ostav etot retranslyator aktivnym, chtoby sohranit obratnyy put.
BEACON_RECOMMEND_RETRACT_NOW: Ty uzhe v distantsii podbora i mozhesh svernut ee seychas.
BEACON_RECOMMEND_RETRACT_ROUTE_NOW: Ty uzhe v distantsii podbora i mozhesh svernut ili perestavit etu marshrutnuyu metku.
BEACON_SUMMARY_EXTENDS_GRID: Eto razvertyvanie rasshiryaet setku mayakov naruzhu.
BEACON_SUMMARY_FIRST_ANCHOR: Eto pervyy yakor v marshrutnoy setke.
BEACON_SUMMARY_FRONTIER: Etot mayak vydvigaet marshrut k novomu rubezhu.
BEACON_SUMMARY_LOCAL_MARK: Etot mayak otmechaet lokalnuyu tochku interesa.
BEACON_SUMMARY_RELAY: Etot mayak retransliruet marshrut mezhdu aktivnymi yakoryami.
BEACON_SUMMARY_ROUTE_ALIGNED: Etot mayak chisto vyrovnen po tekuschemu marshrutu.
BEACON_SUMMARY_ROUTE_GUIDE: Etot mayak mozhet vesti tebya po obratnomu marshrutu.
BEACON_SUMMARY_STANDALONE_ANCHOR: Etot mayak uderzhivaet odinochnuyu yakornuyu pozitsiyu.
COLONIST_ATLAS6_TERMINAL_SECTOR3_DESCRIP: Popytka vzloma sistemy Atlas-6 polzovatelem CHEN_M. Neudachnaya. Data: 847 dney nazad.
COLONIST_BIOLOGIST_SAMPLES_DESCRIPTION: Obraztsy kremnievoy flory s pometkami o «strannom povedenii». Pervye priznaki adaptatsii Atlasa k biomasse.
COLONIST_CAPTAIN_LAST_BROADCAST_DESCRIPT: «Atlas... on ne otvechaet. No my vidim, kak on... rastet.» Obryvaetsya na zvuke skrezheta.
COLONIST_CHEN_M_BLUEPRINT_DESCRIPTION: Shema modifikatsii standartnogo drona Atlas-6. Kto-to pytalsya pereprogrammirovat drona.
COLONIST_CHEN_M_DATAPAD_01_DESCRIPTION: Tehnicheskiy otchet. Skuchnyy. Data: 847 dney nazad.
COLONIST_CHEN_M_SUIT_DESCRIPTION: Skafandr na dne. Ryadom — samodelnyy instrument neizvestnogo naznacheniya.
COLONIST_CHILD_DRAWING_DESCRIPTION: Detskiy risunok. Igrushka ryadom. Nevinnost, kontrastiruyuschaya s katastrofoy.
COLONIST_FIRST_COLONY_MODULE_SPOTTED_DES: Pervaya orientirnaya tsel vstupitelnogo chasa. Dolzhna chitatsya kak dalnyaya tsel, a ne zhestkiy marker.
COLONIST_FIRST_HOUR_SHADOW_EVENT_DESCRIP: Pugayuschiy beat pervogo chasa. Bolshaya bystraya ten sleva dolzhna sbit samouverennost.
COLONIST_MEDIC_DIARY_DESCRIPTION: Opisanie «sindroma glubiny» — gallyutsinatsii, paranoyya. Pustye ampuly.
COLONIST_ZONE_DEEP_ABYSS_DESCRIPTION: Abissalnaya ravnina. Izolyatsiya. Otkaz oborudovaniya smertelen. Zdes povestvovanie dolzhno uhodit v uzhas.
COLONIST_ZONE_DROWNED_FACTORIES_DESCRIPT: Zapadnyy sklon. Zatoplennye moduli kolonii. Pervyy nastoyaschiy skachok davleniya i riska.
COLONIST_ZONE_THERMAL_FIELDS_DESCRIPTION: Riftovye zony. Gidrotermalnye istochniki. Samoe glubokoe zhivoe prostranstvo. Yadro Atlas-6 i final tretego akta.
COLONIST_ZONE_THE_DROP_UPPER_DESCRIPTION: Vostochnaya stena. Rezkiy vertikalnyy obryv. Absolyutnaya tma. Leviafany i perehod v polnoe napryazhenie.
COLONIST_ZONE_THE_SPINE_DESCRIPTION: Startovaya zona. Melkovode pod davleniem. Skalnye grebni, ilovye linii i pervyy urok vidimosti.
CORP_DEEP_REACH_OFFICIAL_MISSION: Kolonizatsiya otdalennyh mirov. Nauchnye issledovaniya. Terraformirovanie.
CORP_DEEP_REACH_PLAYER_BRIEFING: Vy — inzhener-maroder. Minimalnoe obespechenie. Odinochnaya missiya. Korporatsiya gotova poteryat 100 skavendzherov radi 1 kg Xenon-Ω. Vy ne znaete polnoy stoimosti togo, chto sobiraete.
CORP_DEEP_REACH_REAL_MISSION: Dobycha izotopa Xenon-Ω. Testirovanie II Atlas-6 v usloviyah polnoy avtonomii. Voennyy platsdarm v sisteme Aegira.
CORP_FACTION_ETHICS_PHILOSOPHY: Schitayut missiyu prestupnoy. Znali o riskah katastrofy. Hotyat raskryt pravdu.
CORP_FACTION_PRAGMATISTS_PHILOSOPHY: Trebuyut rezultatov lyuboy tsenoy. Poteri priemlemy radi dannyh. Xenon-Ω vazhnee zhizney.
CORP_ISOTOPE_AEGIRIUM_EXCLUSIVITY: Produkt raspada v atmosfere Aegira, osazhdaetsya na lune.
CORP_ISOTOPE_SILICON_7B_EXCLUSIVITY: Obrazuetsya tolko v kremnievyh ekosistemah pod davleniem.
CORP_ISOTOPE_XENON_OMEGA_EXCLUSIVITY: Unikalnoe sochetanie davleniya, temperatury i geohimii Gektona-8.
CORP_ORDER_CONFLICT: KONFLIKT PRIKAZOV - FRAKTsII KORPORATsII NAPRYaMUYu PROTIVOREChAT DRUG DRUGU.
CORP_ORDER_ORDER_EXTRACT_XENON_TEXT: PRIORITET ALFA: Izvlech maksimalnoe kolichestvo Xenon-Ω. Atlas-6 — vtorichnaya tsel. Vozvraschaytes s gruzom.
CORP_ORDER_ORDER_PRESERVE_ECOSYSTEM_TEXT: VNIMANIE: Obnaruzhena dokazatelnaya baza suschestvovaniya zhizni do prihoda lyudey. NE UNIChTOZhAT. Dokumentirovat. Vozvraschaytes s dannymi.
CORP_ORDER_ORDER_PRESERVE_SIGNAL_TEXT: Atlas-6 stroit signal zaschity. Esli eto pravda — ne trogayte ego. Pust signal rabotaet.
CORP_ORDER_ORDER_SHUTDOWN_ATLAS_TEXT: Atlas-6 vyshel iz-pod kontrolya. Unichtozhit yadro. Dannye programmy Poseva — prioritet.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_DEEP_ABYSS_DESCRIPTION: Abissalnaya ravnina. Monotonnyy relef. Izolyatsiya. Otkaz oborudovaniya smertelen.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_DROWNED_FACTORIES_DESCRI: Zapadnyy sklon. Zatoplennye moduli kolonii. Osnovnaya zona issledovaniya.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_THERMAL_FIELDS_DESCRIPTI: Riftovye zony. Gidrotermalnye istochniki. Samoe glubokoe i samoe zhivoe mesto. Yadro Atlas-6.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_THE_DROP_UPPER_DESCRIPTI: Vostochnaya stena. Rezkiy vertikalnyy obryv. Absolyutnaya tma. Leviafany.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_THE_SPINE_DESCRIPTION: Startovaya zona. Melkovode pod davleniem. Skalnye grebni, ilovye linii i marshruty, chitaemye po davleniyu.
ECLIPSE_EVENT_STARTED: VELIKOE ZATMENIE - TEMPERATURA PADAET. NOChNYE HISchNIKI PODNIMAYuTSYa.
ENDING_AMPLIFY_COMPLETE: SIGNAL USILEN. VES SEKTOR SLYShIT. ATLAS-6 ZAVERShAET PROGRAMMU. PRAVDA RASKRYTA. POSLEDSTVIYa NEPREDSKAZUEMY.
ENDING_CORE_REACHED: YaDRO ATLAS-6 OBNARUZhENO. TERMINAL AKTIVEN. VYBERITE DEYSTVIE.
ENDING_LEAVE_COMPLETE: ATLAS-6 PRODOLZhAET RABOTU. SIGNAL AKTIVEN. ZhIZN ZASchISchENA - POKA SIGNAL NE NAYDUT.
ENDING_SHUTDOWN_COMPLETE: ATLAS-6 OTKLYuChEN. SIGNAL PREKRASchEN. KORPORATsIYa POLUChIT DANNYE. TERRAFORMIROVANIE PRODOLZhITSYa.
ENDING_TERMINAL_DATA_LOADED: ATLAS-6: DANNYE PROGRAMMY ZASEVA ZAGRUZhENY. ZhIZN NA HECTON-8 PREDShESTVOVALA PRIBYTIYu LYuDEY. ATLAS-6 SOZDAVAL ZASchITNYY SIGNAL 847 DNEY.

FAUNA_CREATURE_ABYSSAL_NIGHTMARE_DESCRIP: Poluprozrachnyy, pochti nevidimyy v temnote. Svetyatsya tolko glaza i vnutrennie organy. Visit nepodvizhno. Pri priblizhenii — rezko «shlopyvaetsya» k igroku.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ABYSSAL_NIGHTMARE_ROLE: Razryvatel tishiny. Strah derzhitsya na tsene marshruta i akusticheskom preduprezhdenii do kontakta.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_BUILDER_DESCRIPTION: Metallicheskiy korpus s organicheskimi trubkami. Taschit materialy k tochkam sborki. Ne atakuet esli ne meshat. Pri ugroze — vysokochastotnyy pisk, vyzyvaet Zaschitnika.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_BUILDER_ROLE: Pervaya vstrecha s dronami. Neopredelennost strashnee ugrozy.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_COURIER_DESCRIPTION: Malenkiy bystryy dron. Dostavlyaet kapsuly bartera k mayakam. Nikakogo vzaimodeystviya. Prosto — dostavka.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_COURIER_ROLE: Atmosfera: Atlas-6 — ne personazh, a sistema.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DEFENDER_DESCRIPTIO: Boevoy dron. Reagiruet na pisk Stroitelya. Agressiven. Ohranyaet stroitelnye zony i yadro Atlas-6.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DREADNOUGHT_DESCRIP: Biomehanicheskiy gibrid — pomes kraba i promyshlennogo ekskavatora. Na spine — bashni II Atlasa, byuschie rezhuschimi dugami. Ohranyaet yadro i prevraschaet otklyuchenie v boy za marshrut pod davleniem.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DREADNOUGHT_ROLE: Strazh yadra. Trebuet taktiki, kontrolya marshruta i vsego arsenala.
FAUNA_CREATURE_GLASSWORM_DESCRIPTION: Gigantskiy poluprozrachnyy cherv-filtrator. Medlenno izgibaetsya v tolsche vody. Esli zaplyt vnutr — vyplyunet (ne smertelno).
FAUNA_CREATURE_GLASSWORM_ROLE: Iskazhaet marshrut i sonar. Ego telo delaet vidimost vremennoy tsenoy resheniya.
FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_DESCRIPTION: Skat masshtaba apparata s kabelnymi shramami, solyanymi narostami i obryvkami priborov. Kilvater pokazyvaet techenie, no podnimaet shum; eto ne transport.
FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_HABITAT: Shelfy, linii wreckov i napornye techeniya (80-700 m)
FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_ROLE: Signal masshtaba i riska marshruta. Pomechaet techeniya, lomaet siluety i mozhet sdelat vozvrat dorogim.
FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_SCIENCE: Forma skata pravdopodobna; musor i narosty - adaptaciya k davleniyu HECTON-8, ne dekor rifa.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION: Gigantskiy organizm, napolovinu vrosshiy v skalu. Iz steny torchit tolko morda i para lap. Kazhetsya spyaschim. Esli podplyt — golova medlenno povorachivaetsya. Ne atakuet, no vzglyad paralizuet.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_ROLE: Psihologicheskiy barer. Igrok ne znaet, prosnetsya on ili net.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_SCIENCE: Organizmy, vrosshie v substrat — realny (morskie lilii, astsidii).
FAUNA_CREATURE_TERMITE_WORM_DESCRIPTION: Ogromnyy cherv, proryvayuschiy tonneli v skalah. Telo pokryto pantsirem iz metalla i kamnya. Golova — gigantskaya freza. Iznachalno neytralen. Mozhet razrushat postroyki igroka.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TERMITE_WORM_ROLE: Dinamicheskoe izmenenie mira. Otkryvaet novye prohody ili unichtozhaet bazu.
FAUNA_CREATURE_THERMAL_PHANTOM_DESCRIPTI: Poluprozrachnaya meduzoobraznaya tvar. Obitaet na granitse termoklina. Obzhigaet schupaltsami i vytalkivaet naverh — ne smertelno, no bolno.
FAUNA_CREATURE_THERMAL_PHANTOM_SCIENCE: Termoklin realen. Meduzy s termalnymi linzami — gipoteza.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TITAN_LEVIATHAN_DESCRIPTI: Ogromnyy ugor s metallizirovannoy cheshuey i gidravlicheskoy pastyu. Vdol hrebta — svetyaschiesya razryady. Medlenno patruliruet territoriyu. Izdaet nizkochastotnyy gul.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TITAN_LEVIATHAN_ROLE: Glavnyy hischnik. Viden izdaleka. Sozdaet anticipation.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TITAN_LEVIATHAN_SCIENCE: Ogromnye ugri realny. Elektricheskie organy — realny.
FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_DESCRIPTION: Ogromnyy skat s dlinnym hvostom-elektrogeneratorom. Ohranyaet tsennye oblomki. Ne ubivaet, no oglushaet razryadom.
FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_ROLE: Ohranyaet resursy. Zastavlyaet dumat, ne prosto strelyat.
FIRST_HOUR_DEEPER_ROUTE_READ: NIZhE VAZhNEE NE ZhADNOST, A MARShRUT. DERZhI V PAMYaTI SILUET VYHODA I SPOKOYNYY KARMAN.
FIRST_HOUR_DEPTH_REMINDER: PERVAYa NASTOYaSchAYa NAHODKA NIZhE. IDI GLUBZhE, NO NE TERYaY VYHOD.
FIRST_HOUR_FABRICATION_FALLBACK: UZEL DAET PEREDYShKU, NO NE OTVET. VYHODI SNOVA - SILNYY RANNIY PROHOD LEZhIT ChUT GLUBZhE.
FIRST_HOUR_MODULE_ROUTE_READ: TEPER ISchI NE ROSSYP, A SLED. RUINY, MODULI I SLUZhEBNYE OSTANOVKI DADUT NASTOYaSchIY VEKTOR.
FIRST_HOUR_MODULE_SCAN_HINT: SKANIRUY RUINY I MODULI. ZDES ESchE MOZhNO NAYTI ChTO-TO TsELOE.
FIRST_HOUR_RESOURCE_REMINDER_COPPER: ISchI MED V OBLOMKAH I U SKAL. BEZ NEE TY NE SDVINEShSYa DALShE.
FIRST_HOUR_RESOURCE_REMINDER_GENERIC: ISchI PERVYY OPORNYY MATERIAL V OBLOMKAH I VDOL ChITAEMYH SKALNYH KROMOK. BEZ NEGO TsEP OSTANOVITSYa ZDES.
FIRST_HOUR_RESOURCE_SHELF_READ: DERZhIS ChITAEMOY KROMKI. PERVAYa MED OBYChNO SIDIT NIZhE I SBOKU OT SAMOY BEZOPASNOY POLKI.
FIRST_HOUR_RETURN_LORE_RELAY: V SLUZhEBNYH UZLAH MOGLI OSTATSYa ZAPISI I METKI. PROVERYaY TERMINALY I BOKOVYE STOYKI, A NE TOLKO RESURSY.
FIRST_HOUR_STARTER_BACKSLIDE_READ: MELKOVODE TEPER DAET TEBE PEREDYShKU, NO NE PROGRESS. SOBERIS I VERNIS K GLUBINNOMU MARShRUTU.

ITEM_ABYSSAL_CRYSTAL_DESCRIPTION: Redkiy kristall glubinnyh zon dlya samyh prochnyh sistem davleniya i moduley pozdney igry.
ITEM_ABYSS_PRESSURE_SHELL_DESCRIPTION: Glubokovodnyy korpus pozdnego etapa dlya ekstremalnyh davleniy i bezdonnyh uluchsheniy.
ITEM_BATTERY_CELL_DESCRIPTION: Kompaktnaya silovaya yacheyka dlya perenosnyh instrumentov i bazovyh polevyh ustroystv.
ITEM_BEACON_CORE_DESCRIPTION: Avtonomnoe yadro markera dlya marshrutnyh mayakov i dalnih obratnyh putey.
ITEM_BIOLUM_PASTE_DESCRIPTION: Szhataya svetyaschayasya biomassa dlya marshrutnyh metok, temnoy optiki i identifikatsii rele.
ITEM_BUILDER_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION: Ruchnoy instrument fabrikatsii dlya razmescheniya, povorota i demontazha polevyh konstruktsiy.
ITEM_CIRCUIT_BOARD_DESCRIPTION: Bazovaya logicheskaya plata dlya analizatorov, skanerov i tochnoy elektroniki.
ITEM_COBALT_ALLOY_DESCRIPTION: Prochnyy kobaltovyy splav dlya pozdnih korpusov, katushek i ram oruzhiya.
ITEM_COOLING_CARTRIDGE_DESCRIPTION: Smennyy teplootvodyaschiy kartridzh dlya fonarey, rezakov i silovyh regulyatorov.
ITEM_COPPER_DESCRIPTION: Rasprostranennaya provodyaschaya ruda dlya provodki, signalnyh detaley i bazovyh instrumentov.
ITEM_COPPER_WIRE_DESCRIPTION: Bazovaya tokoprovodyaschaya liniya dlya rannih ustroystv, mayakov i upravlyayuschih konturov.
ITEM_CURED_FISH_DESC: Konservirovannyy rybnyy belok. Osnovnoy produkt pitaniya.
ITEM_ELECTROLYTE_AMPOULE_DESCRIPTION: Bystrozaryadnaya ampula dlya stabilizatsii energii kostyuma i perenosnyh polevyh sistem.
ITEM_ELECTROLYTE_SALTS_DESCRIPTION: Reaktivnye solevye klastery dlya yacheek, ohlazhdayuschey himii i stabilizatsii pitaniya.
ITEM_EMERGENCY_O2_CANISTER_DESCRIPTION: Szhatyy avariynyy zapas kisloroda dlya dlinnyh vyhodov i neudachnyh marshrutov.
ITEM_ENZYME_CORAL_DESCRIPTION: Kataliticheskiy mineralno-organicheskiy karbonat dlya svyazuyuschih sostavov i prodvinutyh bio-smesey.
ITEM_FIBER_KELP_DESCRIPTION: Gibkaya organicheskaya lenta dlya setki, svyazok i rannih rabot po kostyumu.
ITEM_FIBER_MESH_DESCRIPTION: Obrabotannoe organicheskoe volokno dlya myagkih uplotneniy, podkladki kostyuma i rukoyatok instrumentov.
ITEM_FIELD_MED_GEL_DESCRIPTION: Meditsinskiy gel, ustoychivyy k davleniyu, dlya lecheniya travm kostyuma i vosstanovleniya tselostnosti.
ITEM_FILTERED_WATER_DESC: Ochischennaya voda iz sistemy filtratsii bazy. Vosstanavlivaet vodnyy balans.
ITEM_GLASS_PANEL_DESCRIPTION: Mineralnaya panel dlya optiki, fonarey i germetichnyh pribornyh litsevyh poverhnostey.
ITEM_GOLD_ORE_DESCRIPTION: Vysokoprovodyaschaya ruda dlya stabilnyh plat, tochnyh kontaktov i optiki.
ITEM_GUIDANCE_MODULE_DESCRIPTION: Tochnoe navigatsionnoe yadro dlya garpunnyh golovok, avtonomnyh markerov i pozdnego navigatsionnogo snaryazheniya.
ITEM_HIGH_CAPACITY_CELL_DESCRIPTION: Pozdnyaya portativnaya yacheyka dlya tyazhelyh instrumentov, paralizatorov i dalnih sistem.
ITEM_HYDRAULIC_ACTUATOR_DESCRIPTION: Privodnoy uzel dlya stroitelnyh sistem, tyagovyh mehanizmov i utilizatsionnyh sborok.
ITEM_HYDROCARBON_RESIN_DESCRIPTION: Lipkaya glubokovodnaya smola dlya polimerov, smazok i germetiziruyuschih smesey pod davlenie.
ITEM_IRON_COMPOSITE_DESCRIPTION: Plotnyy konstruktsionnyy splav dlya rasporok, ram i tyazhelyh platformennyh rabot.
ITEM_LITHIUM_CRYSTAL_DESCRIPTION: Kristall vysokoy plotnosti dlya usilennyh yacheek i pozdnih konstruktsionnyh detaley.
ITEM_LUBRICANT_RESIN_DESCRIPTION: Ochischennyy skolzyaschiy polimer dlya podvizhnyh uplotneniy, aktuatorov i tyazhelyh instrumentov.
ITEM_MEMBRANE_TISSUE_DESCRIPTION: Gibkaya k davleniyu organicheskaya tkan dlya filtrov, uplotneniy i puzyrnyh sistem.
ITEM_NICKEL_ORE_DESCRIPTION: Metall, ustoychivyy k davleniyu, dlya glubokovodnyh konstruktsiy i tyazhelyh polevyh sistem.
ITEM_NUTRIENT_BLOCK_DESC: Szhatyy avariynyy ratsion. Mnogo kaloriy, minimum vkusa.
ITEM_OXYGEN_PIPE_DESC: Avariynyy zapas kisloroda. Bystryy vdoh, kogda on nuzhen bolshe vsego.
ITEM_POWER_COUPLER_DESCRIPTION: Germetichnyy silovoy razem dlya podachi vyrabotannoy energii v moduli i sluzhebnye linii.

LOADING_TIP_10: Tselostnost skafandra padaet ot kontakta s faunoy i davleniya.
